# PLAN — iteration 2
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 was accepted as timing progress: routed setup WNS improved to -0.386 ns from -0.930 ns, with hold at 0.064 ns. Timing remains infeasible. The advisor trial registered `out_valid` and moved the critical path to `in_ready`, reaching -0.073 ns WNS and 0.074 ns WHS; it was not adopted because timing closure was still unmet. The trial points to the occupancy-derived ready path as the next target.

## Hypothesis
Register the FIFO’s full status alongside occupancy and use it to simplify `in_ready`, which may improve setup slack on the output path while preserving the required combinational dependence on `out_ready`.

## Instruction for generator
In `packet_fifo_core`, replace the combinational `occupancy < DEPTH` comparison in `in_ready` with a `full` status register, updated on each clock edge to reflect the post-transfer occupancy and cleared by synchronous reset; retain `in_ready = !full || out_ready`. Handle push, pop, and simultaneous full pop/push correctly for every supported `DEPTH` from 1 through 8, while preserving reset priority, capacity, throughput, and all existing output behavior. Keep the top `// @latency 1` annotation and the registered head data and marker behavior.
